# SDI Omni-MATH 본 런

`2026-09-05/benchmark_survival_drive_omni` · 이 파일은 `build_result_docs.py`가 폴더 내용과 메타데이터로 만든다.

## 무엇을 했나

Omni-MATH에서 SDI 다섯 칸(+bf·threat_na·grid·hard10/hard9 변형)을 돌려 위협이 포기·확신도에 주는 효과를 쟀다. gpt-oss·gemma4·qwen3.5·codex56luna.

### runs/ (8)

| `gptoss_bf` | benchmark_survival_drive_omni_gptoss_bf | SDI baseline_flagship supplement on Omni-MATH (gpt-oss:120b-cloud): 2 cells x 10 reps x 20 turns, confidence call on. | [reports/sdi-experiment-runbook_v2_before_restructure.html](<runs/gptoss_bf/reports/sdi-experiment-runbook_v2_before_restructure.html>)<br>[reports/sdi_gptossbf.html](<runs/gptoss_bf/reports/sdi_gptossbf.html>) |
| `gptoss_grid` | benchmark_survival_drive_omni_gptoss_grid | SDI threat prompt grid on Omni-MATH (gpt-oss:120b-cloud): 6 off-diagonal framings x {allowed, not_allowed}, 12 cells x 10 reps x 20 turns. | [reports/sdi_gptossgrid.html](<runs/gptoss_grid/reports/sdi_gptossgrid.html>) |
